author: Ifmyante
text:
Hi G

I hope I can get to that later!

For the moment, here's something I posted elsewhere (temporarily!):

What we want to do is only limited by how much money we can gather, and it goes far beyond simply helping the poor.

Imagine having enough money to fund and create renewable energy projects
 all over the planet (all that employment; all that clean energy!).
Imagine forming a new currency backed by renewable energy, where if I
give you a 10 KW note, you'll always have 10KW in your wallet. Imagine
forming an international central bank which creates and controls this
currency. Imagine it offering interest free loans as standard. Imagine
that bank funding projects which are beneficial to mankind, rather than
wars, weapons production and fossil fuel dependant machinery.

If you know what "money is debt" means, you'll know the revolution is
coming. It MUST come. This empire has gotten too big, too fat. As Jim
said "they've got the guns, but we've got the numbers". If we can have
the money too, then we can give the world back to the people, and end
slavery forever!

I'll delete this post later today, so please don't anybody quote it

author: Ifmyante
text:
As many of you know, I've been thinking for a long time about this world and the way it's run.

With each passing day I get all the more angry.

I'm angry at the people who've tricked and murdered their way into making slaves of us all.

I'm sickened that most of us don't even know that we're slaves.

I'm disgusted at the high possibility that my children will grow up to be slaves too!

I don't want my children to be slaves, and will do all I can to make sure they grow up free and safe.

I want you to do the same for your children.

Do you know the names of your masters? If not, it's not difficult to find out.

The people who've enslaved us are the families who own the Federal
Reserve (the most malignant force on Earth today) and its international
brothers, who also own the petrochemical companies, the weapons
manufacturers, the massive drug plantations, and so much more.

They manufacture every war, to create out of thin air, new money, to
loan to each of the opposing countries, for the manufacture of weapons,
bought from them!

When these countries can't pay back these loans, they take the national resources in payment.

They rebuild these countries, with their own contractors, creating even more money/debt.

The whole thing makes me sick to my stomach!

It has to stop, and it has to stop now!

The whole farcical story is eloquently told here:

Please watch these movies. Become informed. Become angry!

I'm going to watch the third movie today, and post the link if it speaks as well as the other two.

Just know this:

No god will come and make things better. Only we can do that, and we must!

The World is in a giant crisis right now because of the few people who rule it.

Very soon, Austerity will not just be a word to poke at the Greeks and
the Irish, but it will be enforced upon every citizen of this planet bar
 the few who rule it.

The revolution will happen, because it must happen.

The press will ensure that its leaders will be reviled.

The CIA will ensure that its leaders die by accident.

But the revolution will happen, and we will take our planet, and our freedom back!

We have the internet, and we must protect it and use it.

We must learn all we can about the evil which is taking over our species.

We must ensure we make everybody we can aware of the evil which has befallen us (Please learn, and tell EVERYONE you know)

We must support our scientists and our engineers; not the warmongering banks.

We must fight to become self sufficient, as an international family.

The solution to our problem isn't difficult, but we must all be a part of it.

Then we will thrive!
